integrity: Self-contained algebraic-incidence proof with published numerical inputs; exact stand-alone numerical, parity and conic-grid verification. No independent mathematical audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Necessary condition only; realizability of the remaining (0,5,8) profile and near-freeness of any realization are not proved. Restricts only two smooth conics and five distinct lines with nodes, tacnodes and ordinary transverse triple points in characteristic zero.
title: A unique possible weak-combinatorial profile for nearly free two-conic five-line arrangements
